Liu Zichuan’s Immersive Preparation for "Silent"

Liu Zichuan, the 17-year-old lead actor of the campus drama "Silent," dedicated three months to mastering sign language and invited deaf friends to stay in his home to experience daily life without sound. His commitment aimed to convince audiences of his authenticity as a deaf character, a challenge he embraced even as he balanced high school studies and college entrance exam preparations.

sources.description:
劉子銓與《我們與惡的距離II》

劉子銓身著棕色外套、綠色襯衫和條紋領帶，站在《我們與惡的距離II》的大型宣傳海報前。海報以橙紅色調為主，呈現劇中多位角色的側臉剪影，並標示「The World Between Us: After the Flames」副標題。

海報下方排列了公共電視、CATCHPLAY、iQIYI 及 Prime Video 的平台標誌，並附有「7 這世界會變好嗎？」的宣傳標語。這張照片應為該劇第二季的媒體活動或首映場合拍攝，突顯了劉子銓在劇中扮演的角色胡冠駿。
